shortDescription: BNP Paribas OTC:BNPQF OTC:BNPQY and Google Cloud NASDAQ:GOOG NASDAQ:GOOGL struck a new five-year partnership that expands the French bank's access to Google Cloud's infrastructure and advanced AI capabilities, including Gemini Enterprise and Gemini models, the companies said Thursday.Under the agre…

children: that expands the French bank's access to Google Cloud's infrastructure and advanced AI capabilities, including Gemini Enterprise and Gemini models, the companies said Thursday.

Under the agreement, Alphabet's Google Cloud technologies will support the expansion of BNP Paribas's infrastructure and AI capabilities as it moves towards broader deployment of agentic AI. It will also strengthen its existing multi-cloud and multi-model approach within its established security and data governance framework.

"A multi-cloud and multi-model approach gives us the flexibility to select, for each case, the right model, infrastructure, and level of control to meet our requirements for quality and security while delivering the best balance between cost and value," said Marc Camus, group chief information officer at BNP Paribas
. "This partnership strengthens that approach and expands the options available to our businesses."

In BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking, the new capabilities from Gemini Enterprise will support the planned deployment of AI agents for targeted workflows, and Gemini models will be integrated into the bank's generative AI assistant currently available to its more than 65,000 employees.
class C stock rose 0.9% in early afternoon trading after the tech giant unveiled a crop of new products.

title: BNP Paribas expands Google Cloud pact to support agentic AI
